root_cause: The checkout supported billing=yearly (ten monthly fees, two months free) but /prijzen had no monthly/yearly switch, so visitors could not choose or see the yearly price and CTAs never passed billing=yearly.
prevention: /prijzen has a monthly/yearly toggle; a test ties the yearly prices to the canonical catalogue (monthly x 10) and requires the CTAs to carry billing=yearly.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until public readback of /prijzen on the merged SHA

limitations: Default render stays monthly; yearly is applied by JavaScript or ?billing=yearly
